scope.reason: Reclassify closing certification, principle-summary and applied-legislation sections from stored Hungarian documents; AST roles have no separate feature storage. Read a partial or interim judgment's operative introduction and the kind printed below a header table as opening the operative part; a header label needs its colon; paragraph roles and the decision type have no separate feature storage. Type the reasons printed after the ruling as argumentation, not as the document's tail, in the sections derived from the AST. Read the publisher citation restriction from retained raw records into decision metadata; null or absent restrictions remain absent. Block text folds letter-spaced emphasis through the one shared reading, which also reads a short spaced word beside a spaced word and treats a no-break space as a word gap; only whitespace in block text changes and it has no feature storage of its own. Re-mark anonymisation placeholders from stored Hungarian documents: a placeholder's number and field word end the token, so amounts, years and longer words beside a party label stay text; inline anonymisation marks have no separate feature storage.
